errors.evidence: The description states the price for summer deliveries in 2027 is 31.5 Euro/MWh. However, the data point in the chart is located just above the 30 Euro/MWh line, appearing closer to 31 or 32 Euro/MWh. The value 31.5 is an overly precise and likely inaccurate reading.
The description states that the price for annual deliveries in 2026 is 39.5 Euro/MWh. However, the data point in the right chart for the year 2026 is clearly located on the 40 Euro/MWh grid line.

The description only provides the start and end values for each line plot, omitting all intermediate data points. It fails to mention the data point for 2026 in the left chart (approx. 38 Euro/MWh) and the data points for 2027 and 2028 in the right chart (approx. 33 and 29 Euro/MWh, respectively).
